June 3, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Excalibur Management Corp decreased its stake in General Electric (GE) by 22.7% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Excalibur Management Corp sold 29,275 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 99,664 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.34M, down from 128,939 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Excalibur Management Corp who had been investing in General Electric for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $122.38B market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $14.09. About 56.89M shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 46.78% since June 3, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 59.35% the S&P500.
